text: {"findings":[{"resource_address":"azurerm_network_security_rule.seed","doc_id":"POL-002","attribute":"destination_port_range","title":"azurerm_network_security_rule.seed allows inbound SSH from the internet with destination_port_range set to \"22\" and source_address_prefix set to \"0.0.0.0/0\", which exposes an admin port publicly.","suggestion":"Restrict SSH access to a bastion host or private network, or change the source address prefix to a non-internet range."}]}
